senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="Q01963">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 42:21">Targ. Y. Gen. XLII, 21</cite> <he>מְפַרְפֵּר קדמנן</he> Ar. a. Levita (h. text <he>בהתחננו</he>, cmp. <cite ref="H00040"><he>חָבַט</he></cite>; ed. <he>מפייס לנא</he>).—
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>עבד ומפרפר כל ההוא ליליא</he> (not <cite ref="J00195"><he>יומא</he></cite>) he spent the entire night moving about restlessly, v. <cite ref="D00875"><he>דַּמְדֵּם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 12</cite> <he>הוה מפרפר ומאית</he> struggled in convulsions and died (from starvation). Y. Shebu. III, 34ᶜ bot. <he>חמתיה מפרפר ויהב ליה</he> he saw him (the starving man) in convulsions, when he gave him to eat.
